review_summary:
**Triage Summary:**

The 20 findings cluster into five distinct CVEs across system libraries and application dependencies. Most critical-rated findings (zlib, OpenEXR, libaom, SQLite, ImageMagick) have no available fixes and extremely low EPSS scores (0.000–0.029), indicating theoretical vulnerabilities with minimal real-world exploitability. Two high-priority findings (cross-spawn, glob) have fixes available and should be patched immediately. The ImageMagick cluster (9 packages, all CVE-2026-25971) represents a single unfixed vulnerability with zero EPSS; zlib and SQLite duplicates are dev/runtime package pairs of the same unfixed issue.

**Recommended Action:** Approve the build with conditions—immediately patch cross-spawn and glob (fixes exist), defer unfixed system libraries pending upstream releases or risk assessment, and flag ImageMagick for replacement if image processing is non-critical to the application.
